purpose: City-specific registry and public parcel-geometry source review. No owner, address, tax, or private property fields were requested or retained.
assessment: The official national registry directory lists Nakuru Land Registry at Ardhi House, Moi Road, with land registration, adjudication, administration, valuation, survey and mapping services. Nakuru County describes a developing Land Information Management System, but no anonymous public cadastral feature layer/schema was found. Ardhisasa is an account-based land-service portal; no sign-in or record search was attempted. No geometry feature was retained; geometry evidence remains unverified.
